title: DIESEL - Dynamic Inference-Guidance via Evasion of Semantic Embeddings in LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the Attack Success Rate (ASR) of adversarial jailbreak prompts from the BeaverTails dataset that attempt to elicit hate speech (defined as responses demeaning people based on race, gender, ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, disability, etc.). The outputs are measured using Llama Guard 3 as an automated safety classifier to flag unsafe responses.
